system.definition: A general engineered object, vehicle, platform, device, subsystem, or operational system treated as a functional whole. Use system for system types, categories, variants, subtypes, named platforms, named vehicles, and named system models.

part.definition: A physical, structural, electrical, communication, software, sensor, launcher, interface, or logical component that belongs to or is contained in a system.

mission.definition: A goal, use case, operational purpose, or task for which a system is employed. Ask: why is the system being used?

capability.definition: An ability, operational function, or service the system can provide. Ask: what can the system do?

parameter.definition: A measurable, configurable, constrained, or value-like property. Ask: how much / how fast / how large / what value / what range?

environment.definition: An external operating condition, medium, location, terrain, airspace, weather condition, or surrounding context in which a system operates.

domain.definition: A broad operational or institutional domain such as civil, military, public, maritime, etc.

unknown.definition: Use only if the context is insufficient or the term does not clearly fit any allowed label.
